children: Cracker Barrel Old Country Store Inc. (CBRL) filed a Form 8K - Operations and Financial Condition - with the U.S Securities and Exchange Commission on September 23, 2026.

On September 23, 2026, Cracker Barrel Old Country Store, Inc. (the "Company") issued a press release (the "Press Release") announcing the Company's fiscal 2026 fourth quarter results of operations and projected outlook of certain items for fiscal year 2027. A copy of the Press Release is furnished herewith as Exhibit 99.1 and is incorporated herein by reference.
The full text of this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1067294/000110465926109812/tm2625926d1_8k.htm
Any exhibits and associated documents for this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1067294/000110465926109812/0001104659-26-109812-index.htm
Public companies must file a Form 8-K, or current report, with the SEC generally within four days of any event that could materially affect a company's financial position or the value of its shares.
